rules.title: Ladakh: rental motorcycles from outside are turned back
rules.detail: Outside rentals may reach Leh but not tour Nubra, Pangong or Hanle. Enforced by the local rental cooperative; no government order found. Own motorcycles are fine with papers.

gaps: No source names motorcycles when reporting Zoji La openings; the two open-to-motorcycles dates given (2022 and 2026) are tourist opening dates, and the rest are left empty.
No government order found for the Friday maintenance closure.
The text of the Divisional Commissioner's order of 14 September 2026 was not found; it is known only through the traffic advisory.
The Jammu and Kashmir Traffic Police website was opened but showed no dated advisory; the advisory text was read on a news site.
Exact 2024 reopening date not found; one blog gives about 15 April, a newspaper expected the link in late March.
Sources conflict on whether Zoji La closed at all in winter 2025 to 2026.
Sources conflict on the 2021 reopening date (28 February or 19 April).
Date civilians were first allowed in 2023 and 2025 not found.
The Ladakh order of August 2021 that dropped the permit for Indian citizens was not found; only news reports of it.
No official page states the Ladakh tourist fee amounts, so they are left out.
Kargil district website carries no road status or traffic notices.
The second video gives no filming date; it was published on 9 November 2024.
